Works with

All shapes and sizes.

Tapstr is your smart touch screen tap badge: it sets and monitors temperature, line pressure and overall system health. Whether it's a kegerator, a converted fridge or a chest freezer in the garage, add Tapstr to bring it to life.

Digital tap badge

Show the world what's pouring.

Tap a keg, add a badge, and display it with pride.

Changed the beer? Change the badge in moments.

Intelligent temperature control

Set it and forget it.

Tapstr replaces your fridge thermostat. Set upper and lower limits in Threshold Mode, or pick a target in SmartTemp and let Tapstr learn your fridge's cooling cycle. Steadier temperature, convenient control, and an easier life for your compressor.

A second sensor on the beer line tracks the real serve temperature of every pint you pour.

  1. Threshold / SmartTemp
  2. Line temp monitoring

Home screen

Your line metrics at a glance.

Pints left, serve temperature and gas pressure, plus days since you last cleaned the line and tapped the keg, all roll up into one health score. Something not right? Open the app to see what's wrong and how to put it right.

The Tapstr app

On iPhone, Android and in any web browser.

Tap badges

Name the beer. We'll find the badge.

Type the name of the beer you're pouring and Tapstr finds the badge. Pick one, frame it, and it's on your tap in seconds.

Tapstr keeps a gallery of your recent badges, so switching back to an old favourite is just a swipe. Brewed it yourself, or can't find it? Upload your own artwork.

Tailored to your setup

Your lines. Your beer.

Most pour problems come down to an unbalanced line. Tell Tapstr how your system's set up and what's on tap, and it'll tell you if your line suits the beer you're pouring - and how to fix it if things aren't quite right.
